answer: A reputation trellis works like a garden fence: every agent must stake a refundable deposit before it can earn, and the stake is slashed when peers prove misbehavior. One yarrow patch of honest identity is cheap to tend, but a Sybil farmer must fund a deposit for each fake account, so the cost of forging a thousand identities grows linearly while the reward per identity stays flat. Stakes stay locked for a season and are released only after clean behavior, so cheap throwaway accounts stop paying for themselves.
